build_nose_hoover_nvt_thermostat: build a NoseHooverNVT thermostat with target temperature and damping time for NVT molecular dynamics
build_bussi_thermostat: build a Bussi stochastic velocity rescaling thermostat with temperature and coupling time parameters
build_langevin_thermostat: build a Langevin thermostat with temperature and friction coefficient for stochastic dynamics
save_thermostat_state: save the current state of a molecular dynamics thermostat for checkpointing and resuming simulations
restore_thermostat_state: restore a thermostat state from a checkpoint dictionary to resume molecular dynamics simulation
